<thought>We need to provide a list of SMILES strings for fragments that can be joined to form the molecule. The most direct way to obtain candidate fragments is to use the provided tool `return_possible_fragments`, which generates fragment SMILES for the sample based on the available spectral data. This avoids unnecessary experiments and gives us the required fragment list.</thought>
